slides.texte_overlay:
Quiet details that make
a man look truly cultured
Knowing the story behind what you eat. Why pizza is from Naples, where coffee first grew. A short fact at dinner turns a simple meal into a great conversation.
Recognising a few famous paintings. Not an expert, just enough to say "That's a Monet, right?" in a gallery. Small knowledge, big quiet charm on any date.
Pronouncing foreign names correctly. Croissant, Gnocchi, Van Gogh. Taking a second to learn the right way shows real respect and curiosity for other cultures.
Learning something every single day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and over time it shows in how I talk, travel and see the world.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Over time it shows in how I talk, travel and see the world.

slides.texte_overlay: Listening to music with lyrics in another language. Italian songs, French classics, Brazilian bossa nova. A wide taste in music always says something good about you.
Visiting a local museum on a quiet weekday. No crowds, no rush, just you and the history of your own city. Few things feel as calm and refined as that.
Writing without mistakes. Correct spelling in messages, proper punctuation in emails. Clean writing is a small detail that quietly signals education.
